source_policy.matching: Iterate incoming RegistryDefinition values in order; use definition.id to look up existing Registry value in captured IdentifiedSet. Miss constructs Registry(definition:isPinned:); hit assigns incoming definition and pin low bit. Constructor/setter internals unqualified.
source_policy.missing_preview: On a hit, existing preview none reaches Registry.preview setter with none; no preview creation in this branch.
source_policy.preview_item: For present preview whose item is DiscoveredItem.preview, obtain registryInstance. If present, replace its definition, wrap PreviewInstance.registry and DiscoveredItem.preview and call Preview.update(withItem:). If registryInstance is absent, skip item update while retaining present preview value.
source_policy.registry_item: Present preview whose item is DiscoveredItem.registry receives incoming definition wrapped as registry item through Preview.update(withItem:). Unknown item case diagnoses/traps.
source_policy.retention: All normal existing-present-preview routes wrap a present preview and assign it back; absence of registryInstance does not select the nil-preview route. This is source value retention, not runtime object/session/state preservation.
source_policy.output: Append one registry per incoming definition in input order. Empty input returns empty array. Old IDs not selected by input are omitted without an explicit teardown claim.
source_policy.boundaries: Registry/preview setter effects, duplicate IDs, actual runtime reuse, rows removed, callbacks cancelled, rendered output and OS/transport resources settled remain unqualified.

limitations: Prior locked-screen/empty Accessibility and Ghidra failures not retried unchanged.
